verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions OpenFeature or an OpenFeature provider for Unleash. It only documents Unleash's own SDKs (30+ SDKs, unleash.isEnabled API), which is vendor-specific code rather than a vendor-neutral abstraction. Vendor-neutral SDK integration is a fair axis for a feature-flag product, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API
